artifacts.title: Complete silence after submission
artifacts.summary: No automated receipt, acknowledgement, rejection, or recruiter outreach is received following application submission.

probes.action: Check email spam and security quarantine folders for ATS automated acknowledgement tokens.
probes.expected_signal: Confirms whether application was ingested and generated a confirmation ID.

non_inferences: Does not prove the application was reviewed by a human.
Does not prove the role was cancelled or already filled.
artifacts.content:
# Complete silence after submission

No automated receipt, acknowledgement, rejection, or recruiter outreach is received following application submission.

### Diagnostic Non-Inferences
- Does not prove the application was reviewed by a human.
- Does not prove the role was cancelled or already filled.

artifacts.title: Generic "closer alignment" rejection template
artifacts.summary: Standard automated email stating the team decided to proceed with candidates whose profiles more closely match role requirements.

probes.action: Compare CV keyword density with exact requirement phrases in the published job description.
probes.expected_signal: Reveals potential vocabulary mismatch between candidate phrasing and ATS rubric.

non_inferences: Does not establish which specific skill was deemed insufficient.
Does not establish whether a human reviewer read the full resume.
artifacts.content:
# Generic "closer alignment" rejection template

Standard automated email stating the team decided to proceed with candidates whose profiles more closely match role requirements.

### Diagnostic Non-Inferences
- Does not establish which specific skill was deemed insufficient.
- Does not establish whether a human reviewer read the full resume.

artifacts.title: Position closed after final interview without hire
artifacts.summary: Candidate completes all interview rounds, but is informed that the requisition has been cancelled, frozen, or closed.

probes.action: Politely inquire with recruiter if the position was closed due to business budget restructuring or team reallocation.
probes.expected_signal: Clarifies whether barrier was candidate-specific or macroeconomic/budgetary.

non_inferences: Does not prove candidate failed technical or behavioral evaluations.
Does not prove the company lied about opening intention.
artifacts.content:
# Position closed after final interview without hire

Candidate completes all interview rounds, but is informed that the requisition has been cancelled, frozen, or closed.

### Diagnostic Non-Inferences
- Does not prove candidate failed technical or behavioral evaluations.
- Does not prove the company lied about opening intention.

artifacts.title: Materially similar role reposted shortly after rejection
artifacts.summary: Candidate observes the same or near-identical job listing reposted or refreshed on job boards within 1–8 weeks of rejection.

probes.action: Check job listing requisition ID or ask recruiter whether the posting is an automated ATS refresh or a distinct headcount opening.
probes.expected_signal: Distinguishes between automated job board bot refreshes and genuine recurring hiring demand.

non_inferences: Does not establish that the role was a "fake" or "ghost" posting.
Does not establish that the prior interview feedback was fraudulent.
artifacts.content:
# Materially similar role reposted shortly after rejection

Candidate observes the same or near-identical job listing reposted or refreshed on job boards within 1–8 weeks of rejection.

### Diagnostic Non-Inferences
- Does not establish that the role was a "fake" or "ghost" posting.
- Does not establish that the prior interview feedback was fraudulent.

artifacts.title: Compensation band reduced or altered mid-process
artifacts.summary: Offered or discussed compensation band is revised downward from previously agreed or advertised range.

probes.action: Request clarification on whether the revised band reflects a lower leveling grade or a company-wide budget adjustment.
probes.expected_signal: Separates leveling evaluation outcome from company financial constraints.

non_inferences: Does not prove intentional bait-and-switch malice unless verified by company policy evidence.
artifacts.content:
# Compensation band reduced or altered mid-process

Offered or discussed compensation band is revised downward from previously agreed or advertised range.

### Diagnostic Non-Inferences
- Does not prove intentional bait-and-switch malice unless verified by company policy evidence.

artifacts.title: Take-home assignment exceeding reasonable stated scope
artifacts.summary: Take-home assignment requires building complex production-grade features demanding 20+ hours instead of stated 2–4 hours.

probes.action: Define explicit boundaries and trade-offs in submission README stating assumptions made to fit the agreed timebox.
probes.expected_signal: Tests whether evaluators value scope management and communication over unbounded free work.

non_inferences: Does not prove the company is harvesting free intellectual property for production use.
artifacts.content:
# Take-home assignment exceeding reasonable stated scope

Take-home assignment requires building complex production-grade features demanding 20+ hours instead of stated 2–4 hours.

### Diagnostic Non-Inferences
- Does not prove the company is harvesting free intellectual property for production use.

artifacts.title: Multiple interview reschedulings or interviewer no-show
artifacts.summary: Interviews are repeatedly postponed, delayed at short notice, or interviewer fails to join scheduled call.

probes.action: Offer clear flexible availability slots and confirm contact details 2 hours prior to the call.
probes.expected_signal: Minimizes scheduling friction and verifies recruiter responsiveness.

non_inferences: Does not imply candidate rejection; frequently reflects interviewer calendar congestion or emergency incidents.
artifacts.content:

Interviews are repeatedly postponed, delayed at short notice, or interviewer fails to join scheduled call.

probes.action: Review interview problem solution against industry standard patterns and identify edge cases missed.
probes.expected_signal: Verifies whether candidate code truly lacked required optimization or rigor.

non_inferences: Does not imply general incompetence; reflects threshold for this specific role level.

barriers.title: Application Ingestion
barriers.description: The initial ingestion gate where candidate CV and structured application fields enter the talent acquisition database / ATS.
barriers.pass_condition: Application record is successfully received, validated for minimum schema, and linked to the active job requisition.
barriers.content:
# Application Ingestion

The initial ingestion gate where candidate CV and structured application fields enter the talent acquisition database / ATS.

### Pass Condition
Application record is successfully received, validated for minimum schema, and linked to the active job requisition.

barriers.title: Automated Filter & Parser Threshold
barriers.description: Algorithmic text extraction, keyword scoring, compliance screening (location/work authorization), and knockout question evaluations.
barriers.pass_condition: CV parsing achieves sufficient extraction score and candidate passes all mandatory algorithmic gating rules.
barriers.content:
# Automated Filter & Parser Threshold

Algorithmic text extraction, keyword scoring, compliance screening (location/work authorization), and knockout question evaluations.

### Pass Condition
CV parsing achieves sufficient extraction score and candidate passes all mandatory algorithmic gating rules.

barriers.title: Sourcing & Inbound Triage
barriers.description: Recruiter or sourcing coordinator manual review of parsed inbound applications vs active outbound talent pipelines.
barriers.pass_condition: Recruiter assigns application to the active short-list for initial conversational outreach.
barriers.content:
# Sourcing & Inbound Triage

Recruiter or sourcing coordinator manual review of parsed inbound applications vs active outbound talent pipelines.

### Pass Condition
Recruiter assigns application to the active short-list for initial conversational outreach.

barriers.title: Recruiter Screening Call
barriers.description: Initial conversational interview evaluating salary expectations, timeline, communication, English fluency, and high-level role alignment.
barriers.pass_condition: Recruiter and candidate align on core parameters and candidate is submitted to hiring team.
barriers.content:
# Recruiter Screening Call

Initial conversational interview evaluating salary expectations, timeline, communication, English fluency, and high-level role alignment.

### Pass Condition
Recruiter and candidate align on core parameters and candidate is submitted to hiring team.

barriers.title: Technical Screen / Live Assessment
barriers.description: Synchronous technical evaluation assessing core technical competencies, problem-solving speed, and system architecture fundamentals.
barriers.pass_condition: Candidate achieves passing score on technical evaluation rubric from the assessing engineer.
barriers.content:
# Technical Screen / Live Assessment

Synchronous technical evaluation assessing core technical competencies, problem-solving speed, and system architecture fundamentals.

### Pass Condition
Candidate achieves passing score on technical evaluation rubric from the assessing engineer.

barriers.title: Take-Home / Work Sample Evaluation

barriers.pass_condition: Code artifact satisfies architectural, functional, test coverage, and documentation requirements.
barriers.content:
# Take-Home / Work Sample Evaluation

### Pass Condition
Code artifact satisfies architectural, functional, test coverage, and documentation requirements.

barriers.title: Hiring Manager In-Depth Review

barriers.pass_condition: Hiring manager confirms candidate has required depth and approves progression to final panel.

# Hiring Manager In-Depth Review

barriers.title: Team & Cross-Functional Panel

barriers.pass_condition: Consensus score among team panelists meets or exceeds hire recommendation threshold.

barriers.title: Compensation & Leveling Reconciliation

- **Removability:** `candidate`

mechanisms.title: Inflated Requisition Requirements vs Actual Team Needs
mechanisms.summary: Job description demands 10+ niche technologies and Staff-level qualifications for a straightforward feature engineering role.
non_inferences: Failing to meet an inflated "wishlist" does not mean candidate cannot excel at the team’s actual core tasks.
mechanisms.content:
# Inflated Requisition Requirements vs Actual Team Needs

Job description demands 10+ niche technologies and Staff-level qualifications for a straightforward feature engineering role.

### Structural Context
- **Actor:** `hiring-manager`
- **Nature:** `incentive`
- **Removability:** `intermediary`

### Non-Inferences
- Failing to meet an inflated "wishlist" does not mean candidate cannot excel at the team’s actual core tasks.

patterns.title: Seniority Double Bind
patterns.summary: Candidate is simultaneously rejected as overqualified for junior/mid roles and underqualified (or insufficiently specialized) for staff/leadership roles.
patterns.trigger_rule: Candidate observes rejection for overqualification at level N and skill-depth shortfall at level N+1 within the same market cycle.
establishes: Candidate falls into an evaluation boundary gap where compensation/experience expectations mismatch standard job tiers.
non_inferences: Does not establish that the candidate lacks market value.
Does not establish malice or coordinated collusion between employers.
patterns.content:
# Seniority Double Bind

Candidate is simultaneously rejected as overqualified for junior/mid roles and underqualified (or insufficiently specialized) for staff/leadership roles.

### Trigger Rule
Candidate observes rejection for overqualification at level N and skill-depth shortfall at level N+1 within the same market cycle.

### What this Establishes
- Candidate falls into an evaluation boundary gap where compensation/experience expectations mismatch standard job tiers.

### What this Does NOT Establish
- Does not establish that the candidate lacks market value.
- Does not establish malice or coordinated collusion between employers.

patterns.title: Closed-Then-Reposted Requisition Motif
patterns.summary: A candidate completes multiple late-stage interviews, is rejected with a generic message, and sees the identical role reposted weeks later.
patterns.trigger_rule: Candidate observes role closure/rejection followed by public reopening of materially similar role listing within 60 days.
establishes: The requisition requirements or target profile were not satisfied by the interviewed pool, or search criteria changed mid-process.
non_inferences: Does not establish that the original job listing was fake or a ghost job.
Does not establish that candidate was intentionally misled.
patterns.content:
# Closed-Then-Reposted Requisition Motif

A candidate completes multiple late-stage interviews, is rejected with a generic message, and sees the identical role reposted weeks later.

### Trigger Rule
Candidate observes role closure/rejection followed by public reopening of materially similar role listing within 60 days.

### What this Establishes
- The requisition requirements or target profile were not satisfied by the interviewed pool, or search criteria changed mid-process.

### What this Does NOT Establish
- Does not establish that the original job listing was fake or a ghost job.
- Does not establish that candidate was intentionally misled.

patterns.title: Experience-Age Impossibility
patterns.summary: Requisition requires more years of hands-on experience in a specific framework or tool than that technology has existed in the open-source ecosystem.
patterns.trigger_rule: Job description or automated screen requires X years of experience where X > technology_age.
establishes: Job description was authored without technical review, using copy-paste templates with automated gating rules.
non_inferences: Does not imply technical team is incompetent, only that HR screening pipeline lacks technical validation.
patterns.content:
# Experience-Age Impossibility

Requisition requires more years of hands-on experience in a specific framework or tool than that technology has existed in the open-source ecosystem.

### Trigger Rule
Job description or automated screen requires X years of experience where X > technology_age.

### What this Establishes
- Job description was authored without technical review, using copy-paste templates with automated gating rules.

### What this Does NOT Establish
- Does not imply technical team is incompetent, only that HR screening pipeline lacks technical validation.

patterns.title: Compensation Double Bind
patterns.summary: Candidate is required to state salary expectation first; quoting high triggers immediate rejection, while quoting low triggers leveling downranking.
patterns.trigger_rule: Asymmetric salary inquiry where employer refuses band disclosure prior to candidate submitting binding number.
establishes: Information asymmetry is utilized as an uncalibrated gatekeeper before technical merit is evaluated.
non_inferences: Does not mean employer has unlimited budget or malice.
patterns.content:
# Compensation Double Bind

Candidate is required to state salary expectation first; quoting high triggers immediate rejection, while quoting low triggers leveling downranking.

### Trigger Rule
Asymmetric salary inquiry where employer refuses band disclosure prior to candidate submitting binding number.

### What this Establishes
- Information asymmetry is utilized as an uncalibrated gatekeeper before technical merit is evaluated.

### What this Does NOT Establish
- Does not mean employer has unlimited budget or malice.

loops.title: Employment Gap Penalty Loop
loops.summary: An initial gap in employment triggers automated ATS downranking, resulting in fewer interview invitations, which extends the employment gap.
loops.content:
# Employment Gap Penalty Loop

An initial gap in employment triggers automated ATS downranking, resulting in fewer interview invitations, which extends the employment gap.

### Cycle Dynamics
This causal loop reinforces mechanisms across iterations:
- `HOBA-M-011` amplifies `HOBA-M-008`
- `HOBA-M-008` amplifies `HOBA-M-009`
- `HOBA-M-009` amplifies `HOBA-M-011`

interventions.title: Auto-Close Stale Job Requisitions
interventions.summary: Implement automated ATS policy to expire public listings when headcount authorization lapses or no interview activity occurs within 60 days.
expected_effects: Reduce stale public listings and candidate application waste
interventions.content:
# Auto-Close Stale Job Requisitions

Implement automated ATS policy to expire public listings when headcount authorization lapses or no interview activity occurs within 60 days.

### Expected Effects
- Reduce stale public listings and candidate application waste
- Reduce ambiguous post-application silence

### Measurements
- `stale_requisition_rate`
- `closure_latency_days`

interventions.title: Upfront Compensation Band Disclosure
interventions.summary: Publish verified salary and equity bands directly in job descriptions or disclose them prior to scheduling technical interview rounds.
expected_effects: Reduce time wasted on mismatched leveling conversations
interventions.content:
# Upfront Compensation Band Disclosure

Publish verified salary and equity bands directly in job descriptions or disclose them prior to scheduling technical interview rounds.

### Expected Effects
- Eliminate late-stage compensation mismatch dropouts
- Reduce time wasted on mismatched leveling conversations

### Measurements
- `late_stage_compensation_drop_rate`
- `candidate_pipeline_satisfaction`

interventions.title: Standardized Late-Stage Rejection Feedback Taxonomy
interventions.summary: Provide candidates reaching technical or panel stages with structured, rubric-based feedback categories rather than generic templates.
expected_effects: Provide actionable feedback signals to candidates
Enforce consistent interviewer calibration across rounds
interventions.content:
# Standardized Late-Stage Rejection Feedback Taxonomy

Provide candidates reaching technical or panel stages with structured, rubric-based feedback categories rather than generic templates.

### Expected Effects
- Provide actionable feedback signals to candidates
- Enforce consistent interviewer calibration across rounds

### Measurements
- `informative_feedback_ratio`
- `interviewer_calibration_variance`

interventions.title: Remove Career Gap Feature from Automated Ranking Models
interventions.summary: Disable employment duration gap penalties in recruitment AI algorithms and screening models.
expected_effects: Broaden candidate pool to include skilled returning talent
interventions.content:
# Remove Career Gap Feature from Automated Ranking Models

Disable employment duration gap penalties in recruitment AI algorithms and screening models.

### Expected Effects
- Break algorithmic unemployment penalty loop
- Broaden candidate pool to include skilled returning talent

### Measurements
- `gap_candidate_screen_rate`
- `long_term_placement_success`

interventions.title: Candidate ATS Parser Conformance Test Utility
interventions.summary: Provide candidates with an open-source parsing validation tool to verify CV machine-readability before submission.
expected_effects: Increase candidate confidence in resume ingestion fidelity
interventions.content:
# Candidate ATS Parser Conformance Test Utility

Provide candidates with an open-source parsing validation tool to verify CV machine-readability before submission.

### Expected Effects
- Eliminate formatting-induced silent parsing failures
- Increase candidate confidence in resume ingestion fidelity

### Measurements
- `parser_extraction_error_rate`
- `ingestion_pass_rate`

interventions.title: Strict Take-Home Timebox & Blinded Evaluation Rubric
interventions.summary: Enforce strict 3-hour scope limits on take-homes, compensate candidates for extended samples, and grade submissions blind.
expected_effects: Prevent reviewer fatigue and asymmetric code evaluation
Respect candidate time investment and eliminate IP exploitation concerns
interventions.content:
# Strict Take-Home Timebox & Blinded Evaluation Rubric

Enforce strict 3-hour scope limits on take-homes, compensate candidates for extended samples, and grade submissions blind.

### Expected Effects
- Prevent reviewer fatigue and asymmetric code evaluation
- Respect candidate time investment and eliminate IP exploitation concerns

### Measurements
- `take_home_completion_rate`
- `inter_rater_rubric_correlation`
